data.name: KLF_WelcomePopup_Text
data.value: 欢迎来到 KSA 的 pre-alpha 版本。<Separator/>目前游戏让你操控的是一艘名为「Rocket」的飞船。按 <Action:VesselNext />、<Action:VesselPrevious/> 可以在几艘可用飞船之间切换。<NewLine/>你可以按 <Action:CameraReferenceFrame/> 切换相机模式，或者按住鼠标右键拖动来平移视角。大多数 UI 元素都可以通过点击拖拽来移动位置、调整大小或隐藏。<NewLine/>KSA 使用的是相当传统的飞船操作方式，你可以按 <Action:OpenGameSettings/> 打开设置菜单，在其中「Controls」一节查看。<NewLine/>按 <Action:ToggleMap/> 可以在飞船视图和地图视图之间切换。地图视图对规划变轨、交会和探索太阳系很有用，不过在这个模式下操作方式会稍有不同。你也可以在地图上左键点击轨道上的某一点来规划变轨。<NewLine/>在菜单栏中，你可以用「Universe」->「Goto」瞬间移动到其他天体，也可以用「View」->「Orbit Lines」为众多天体开启或关闭轨道线。菜单栏里还有不少仍在开发中的功能等待你去发掘。<NewLine/>用 <Action:SimSpeedIncrease/> 可以提高时间压缩倍率，用 <Action:SimSpeedDecrease/> 可以降低。用 <Action:ToggleGroundTracking/> 可以切换地面跟踪，用 <Action:ToggleTransferPlan/> 可以切换转移规划。<Separator/>
data.comment: Welcome to the KSA pre-alpha.<Separator/>The game currently has you controlling a craft named 'Rocket'. Press <Action:VesselNext />, <Action:VesselPrevious/> to swap between several available craft.<NewLine/>You can press <Action:CameraReferenceFrame/> to switch between the camera modes, or hold right click to pan the camera around. Most UI elements can be repositioned, resized and hidden, by clicking and dragging.<NewLine/>KSA uses fairly traditional craft controls, which can be viewed in the 'Controls' section of the settings menus by pressing <Action:OpenGameSettings/>.<NewLine/>Press <Action:ToggleMap/> to toggle between craft view, and map view. The map view can be useful for planning burns for encounters and exploring the solar system, but controls slightly change while in this mode. You can also use this to prepare burns by left clicking on a point in the orbit.<NewLine/>In the menu bar, you can use 'Universe' -> 'Goto' and you can instantly move to other celestial objects as well as using 'View' -> 'Orbit Lines' to enable or disable orbit lines for the many available celestials. Many other in progress features can be accessed by exploring the menu bar.<NewLine/>Time compression can be increased using <Action:SimSpeedIncrease/> and decreased with <Action:SimSpeedDecrease/>. Ground Tracking can be toggled with <Action:ToggleGroundTracking/> and transfer planning with <Action:ToggleTransferPlan/>.<Separator/>
